title: Integration Engineer
description:
**About the role** 




 We're hiring an Integration Engineer to build and maintain the connections between systems that were never designed to talk to each other, and to keep those connections reliable once they're live.
 



 This is hands\\-on work. You'll be moving data between APIs, databases and file feeds, figuring out why a partner's payload changed shape overnight, and building the error handling that stops a silent failure from becoming a client problem. If you like the puzzle of making mismatched systems agree with each other, you'll enjoy this.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Design, build and maintain integrations using REST and SOAP APIs
* Work with JSON and XML payloads, including transformation and validation
* Write and optimise SQL, stored procedures and database views
* Build and support file\\-based integrations over SFTP, including CSV and XML processing
* Implement webhooks and status callbacks, and handle authentication and certificate\\-based connectivity
* Document interfaces clearly using Swagger and OpenAPI
* Test thoroughly with tools like Postman before anything reaches production
* Build the logging, monitoring and error handling that makes troubleshooting fast when something breaks



**What we're looking for** 



* 3\\+ years building system integrations in a professional setting
* Solid experience with REST and SOAP APIs, and with JSON and XML
* Working knowledge of SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or a similar database, including stored procedures, views and query writing
* Comfort with at least one of Java, C\\#, .NET, Node.js or Python
* Familiarity with Git and version control practices
* A methodical approach to error handling, logging and troubleshooting
* Clear written communication in English, since you'll be documenting your work and coordinating with people in other timezones



 You don't need every item on this list. Depth in integration work matters more than ticking every box, and we'd rather hear from someone strong in most of it than not hear from you at all.
 



**Nice to have** 



* Experience integrating with third\\-party or client\\-owned systems where you don't control both ends
* Exposure to message queues or event\\-driven patterns
* Experience working with international clients or distributed teams



**Details** 



* Remote
* Full\\-time



**How to apply** 



* Send your CV to contact@actinode.com with the subject line "Application: Integration Engineer". A short note about an integration you've built and what made it tricky will get our attention faster than a cover letter.
